narration: In month {fork_month}, with no pay since the layoff and a final round still weeks off, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, with more of the ghost's pay claimed before each month began. The ghost's money touched its lowest after the split in month {ghost_lowest_month}, the same month it moved ahead of yours. At the close, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Its cushion was a little thicker, with Safety {safety_gap}. Both lives were close to only getting by, the ghost's Life {life_gap}.
